_review_status: DRAFT - placeholder content written by a developer. Must be co-designed and reviewed with autistic adults and employment specialists before any use with participants.

scenarios.title: A colleague is worried about a deadline
scenarios.prompt: Your colleague Sam says: "I've been here since 7am and I still don't think I'll finish the report by Friday. I'm really stressed about it."
scenarios.goal: Acknowledge what Sam said and respond to the concern they shared.
example_responses: That sounds like a really long day. Is there any part of the report I could help with?
Being here since 7 is a lot. Would it help to ask our manager about Friday?

scenarios.title: A teammate shares good news
scenarios.prompt: Your teammate Priya says: "I just heard the client approved our proposal! I worked on it for weeks."
scenarios.goal: Recognise the news and respond to what Priya shared.
example_responses: Congratulations! You put weeks into that proposal. What happens next with the client?
That's great news, well done. How did you hear?

scenarios.title: Your manager gives a correction
scenarios.prompt: Your manager says: "The spreadsheet you sent had a few numbers in the wrong column. It's an easy mistake, but the client noticed."
scenarios.goal: Acknowledge the feedback and say what you will do next.
example_responses: Thanks for telling me. I'll fix the columns and resend it today.
Sorry about that. Which numbers were wrong, so I can double-check them?

scenarios.title: A colleague returns after being unwell
scenarios.prompt: Your colleague Alex says: "Morning. I'm back, but I'm still not feeling 100% after being off sick last week."
scenarios.goal: Respond to what Alex said about how they are.
example_responses: Welcome back. Sorry you're still not feeling 100%. Let me know if you need anything.
Glad you're back. Hope you feel better soon - do you want me to fill you in on last week?
